meta.title: Multiview · Multi-pane workspace
meta.description: Open up to three conversations side by side in the main window. Double-click a session to add a pane, toggle each pane between chat and trajectory, and close it from the top bar.

emptyHint: Double-click any session on the left to open another pane. A single click navigates the focused pane.
noSession: Choose or create a session on the left.
